name: Fiermuraille
summary:
Fiermuraille is a narrative game playable directly in your browser, inspired by choose-your-own-adventure books.

You explore, you choose, and you trigger stories that are sometimes useful, sometimes absurd, and often unexpected. With its slightly twisted humor, well-hidden secrets, and decisions that truly shape what happens next, every playthrough feels different.

In short, you move forward… and Fiermuraille decides whether it lets you.
